description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity class 'BackupRestoreActivity' that demonstrates backup and restore mechanisms using Android's BackupManager API. It manages UI components for user preferences, reads/writes persistent data, and initiates backup/restore operations.

classes.name: BackupRestoreActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating backup and restore functionality with UI controls for user preferences.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and loads persistent data.

methods.name: populateUI
methods.description: Configures UI based on stored data, creating default data if necessary, and sets change listeners.

methods.name: writeDataToFileLocked
methods.description: Writes current UI state to a data file.

methods.name: recordNewUIState
methods.description: Reads UI state, writes to data file, and signals backup manager for data backup.

methods.name: onRestoreButtonClick
methods.description: Handles restore button click to initiate data restore and update UI after completion.
